overview:
**Fire danger is High today across the Montrose High Elevation zone, driven by warm, dry fuels (ERC 76%, BI 66%) and low humidity.**
- High danger holds every day through September 11, with ERC ticking up toward 80% by midweek.
- Light ENE-NE winds (6-9 mph), afternoon highs in the upper 60s-70s, and only trace rain keep fuels receptive to ignition.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met, and no Red Flag Warning is in effect for the area today.
- Stage 2 fire restrictions have been lowered to Stage 1, effective Friday, September 5, for BLM lands in Montrose, San Miguel, Ouray, Delta, and part of Gunnison County, while the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests removed all fire restrictions effective September 3, 2026.
- The Elk Fire, 7 miles northwest of Lake City in Hinsdale County, is 7,257 acres and 73% contained, showing minimal fire behavior with area closures still in place.
